_doc: ⚑ THE MAP (S145, 2026-09-16 — docs/reinterp/THE_WITNESS_SYSTEM_PLAN_2026-09-16.md §3A). FRAME VOICE: this is the game menu's 'Where you are' and the idle helper's one line — the frame explaining the piece, which it may, because the frame never plays. Four eras; each a list of beats in the order the spine walks them. `done` is a condition key resolved in src/witness/map.ts against the ledger and the OS (conditions in code, content in data — the guide's own pattern); `hint` is the plain line for what to do; `where` the plain direction; `optional` beats are shown but are never 'current' (the piece does not require them); `quiet` beats never raise the helper (felt / respite / the Close: nothing plain is allowed to speak over them). Nothing here is display text in the fiction and nothing here files.
title: Where you are
row: Where you are — and what is next
readFile: Read your file — the entries and their sources
_docCloseBeats: ⚑ S209 / B27 (REVIEW_ROUND_5, ERA26-10): the Close's own optional beats, in the frame's plain voice — so the panels, the card on Daniel's machine and the way out are on the map rather than found by luck. Optional (○): the map lists them, nothing pushes.

closeBeats.label: The panels in the sky
closeBeats.hint: Look up. Press a panel to read it; press it again to turn it to its sources.

closeBeats.label: Daniel's machine
closeBeats.hint: Behind you, on the desk: the receipt, Start again, and the dossier.

closeBeats.label: Who made this
closeBeats.hint: One of the stars is the makers' — how this was made, and with what.

closeBeats.label: Leave
closeBeats.hint: The menu has Leave, whenever you are ready.

closeHint: Look up. Then read the four panels, and the screen on the desk.

beats.label: The questionnaire
beats.hint: Answer the questions on the screen — pick the pictures and the words that fit.

beats.label: The disk
beats.hint: Open the disk — the A: icon on the desktop, or the disk on the desk.

beats.label: Un-Walk, the programme
beats.hint: Read the programme: step 1 on its First Steps page, then Done.

beats.label: The prayer
beats.hint: Step 2: play the companion tape and follow the words to the end.

beats.label: The pledge card
beats.hint: Step 3: the card — sign it in your name, or set it aside.

beats.label: Going online
beats.hint: Step 4: connect — the Internet Setup Wizard dials the fellowship.

beats.label: The fellowship's page
beats.hint: The browser opened on the fellowship's page. Join #stillstruggling at the top — or browse the pages first; the channel waits.

beats.label: The web and the ring
beats.hint: Search, open the directory, or follow the ring: every page leads to another ministry.

beats.label: The channel
beats.hint: Say something in the channel — pick a reply.

beats.label: The wall behind you
beats.hint: Turn around. Something on the wall is keeping notes.

beats.label: Rob's request
beats.hint: MentorRob has asked to message you privately. Accept the request.

beats.label: The picture
beats.hint: MentorRob is sending you a picture. Accept it, then close the viewer.

beats.label: The private message
beats.hint: Someone has written to you privately. Answer.

beats.label: The placement letter
beats.hint: A letter has arrived on the screen — read it and press Ok.

beats.label: The Family Form
beats.hint: Your mentor's form is on the desktop now. Open it.

beats.label: DIARY.TXT
beats.hint: Open DIARY.TXT and write.

beats.label: The racket on the wall
beats.hint: The racket and the Release Work sheet hang on the wall by the bed. Press either.
beats.where: the wall by the bed, to your left

beats.label: Root Cause Digger
beats.hint: A game came with the disk — ROOTCAUSE.EXE on the desktop. Dig, if you like.

beats.label: Your handheld
beats.hint: Your handheld is on the bed. Pick it up; once the disk has come, it has a game.

beats.label: The update
beats.hint: An update notice will arrive on its own. Answer it when it does.

beats.label: The assistant
beats.hint: The assistant is waiting on the screen. Let it begin.

beats.label: The daily check-in
beats.hint: Open the check-in on the desktop and answer it.

beats.label: Your story — the request
beats.hint: Restorify's new video wants you in it. Open Your Story on the desktop and go through the topics.

beats.label: The release
beats.hint: The release is already filled in. Agree to it.

beats.label: The tapes
beats.hint: Play Daniel's take on the tape through to the end, then send it to editing.

beats.label: The edit
beats.hint: The editor assembles the story. Press Next cut until Export is offered, then export it.

beats.label: Your story, online
beats.hint: See where your story went, watch it, and close the page.

beats.label: Your file (read only)
beats.hint: Your file came with you: the folder on the desktop, read only. Open it.

beats.label: Harbor Forums
beats.hint: A thread was recommended to you: the Harbor Forums icon on the desktop.

beats.label: The application
beats.hint: Harbor's Apply page: the programme's application, already filled in.

beats.label: CLEAR
beats.hint: Your phone on the desk has a game on it now.

beats.label: A summons
beats.hint: When the screen sends you somewhere, a marker appears on the floor. Press it to go — or stay.

beats.label: A message from outside
beats.hint: A message has arrived. Open it.

beats.label: The thread
beats.hint: Answer him — pick what you would say.

beats.label: The intervention
beats.hint: Read the alert, then open the mail and continue.

beats.label: What is left
beats.hint: One line is left on the screen. Press it when you are ready.

beats.label: The update
beats.hint: An update notice will arrive on its own. Answer it when it does.

beats.label: The migration
beats.hint: Continue on the screen — the file is being moved to the new service.

beats.label: Sign in
beats.hint: Sign in on the workstation.

beats.label: Lambient's question
beats.hint: Answer the assistant's question — either answer works.

beats.label: Two pieces of work
beats.hint: Work a story through to its end — apply or skip, your choice — then another story, or another job. Annette's family calls are on the board.

beats.label: Your record
beats.hint: Your record is on the platform — the chip at the bottom of the screen.

beats.label: The other jobs
beats.hint: The board has more — in any order, or none.

beats.label: Tag the video
beats.hint: On the board: Tag the video.

beats.label: Post to the group
beats.hint: On the board: Post to the group.

beats.label: The phone
beats.hint: Pick up the phone — it has a message. Unlock it and open the thread.
beats.where: the phone on its stand, left of the monitor

beats.label: The vote
beats.hint: The group's link on the phone — open it, and the second one that follows.

beats.label: The group
beats.hint: Open the link on the phone. The group answers.

beats.label: The update
beats.hint: An update notice will arrive on its own. Answer it when it does.

beats.label: The screensaver
beats.hint: The monitor is asleep on its mark — press it to restore the session.

beats.label: L, on the laptop
beats.hint: The laptop is restoring your session — wait for it, then start with the search.

beats.label: The search, finished
beats.hint: Open the search and let the engine finish it. Read the results.

beats.label: Second Thoughts
beats.hint: The first result is a site. Open it, start a session, and let the agent begin.

beats.label: The console
beats.hint: The console on the bed. Pick it up.

beats.label: L's five turns
beats.hint: L asks, you answer — then each step's own press. Continue moves you on; nothing moves by itself.

beats.label: The headset
beats.hint: Put the headset on — press it, on the desk.

beats.label: The session on the glass
beats.hint: Sit with it. A link will come — press it.

beats.label: The Commons
beats.hint: Stay. Turn to look. The markers on the floor move you.

beats.label: The update fails
beats.hint: Watch the screens.

_docS201: ⚑ S201 — the map follows the new flow (his 'use the narrative helpers… to help navigate this space. It is better to have people do stuff than to panic in waiting'): 1997's browser is a required beat before the channel, the picture Rob sends is a required beat before his message, and the pages, the games, the forum, the application and the 2016 jobs are listed as optional — the menu's 'Where you are' shows them, and the idle helper names the required next step.
_docP7: ⚑ Phase 7 (his: 'the Where you are is not updated') — the phone's place says where the phone is now (on its stand left of the monitor since R4-35, not 'look down, a little to your left'); 2003's read-only folder is on the map (○); the racket's place follows it to the wall by the bed.
_docS205: ⚑ S205 — 2003's testimony is the era's main path now (s2_testimony.json): the request, the release, the tapes, the edit, the page. Caleb's message comes after it.
